components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action — Entrar, Crear cuenta, Publicar, Guardar.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #208AEF; color: #fff; padding: 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; width: 100%; transition: opacity 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #14579f; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.8; }

components.name: WhatsApp Contact Button
components.description: The single, exclusive contact action — opens a WhatsApp deep link.
components.css: .ds-btn-whatsapp { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #25D366; color: #fff; padding: 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; width: 100%; } .ds-btn-whatsapp:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-whatsapp:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #12895c; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Filled destructive action — currently only Cerrar sesión (Desactivar/Reportar use the text-only variant instead; see Do's and Don'ts).
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: #d92d20; color: #fff; padding: 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; width: 100%; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #911811; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Every form field in the app — same border, radius and padding regardless of context.
components.css: .ds-input { border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; font-size: 16px; width: 100%; background: transparent; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #208AEF; outline: none; }

narrative.overview: Cuervo Pass exists for the exact moment a student decides on housing they cannot see in person. The interface earns trust the way a good moving company does: nothing flashy, nothing that calls attention to itself, everything legible, predictable, and clearly working. This is an Operate-mode product — task completion (find, publish, contact, confirm) always outranks expression. Right now the system is deliberately plain: one accent color, system typography, no shadows, no illustration, no custom iconography. That plainness is currently more accident than decision — it is the byproduct of building screen-by-screen against a 12-week deadline rather than a chosen aesthetic. This file documents what exists today so future screens stay consistent with it; treat the flatness as a floor to build on, not a philosophy to defend.
keyCharacteristics: One primary accent (#208AEF), used for calls-to-action and links only — never decoratively.
Flat everywhere: no shadows, no gradients, no elevation system yet.
System typography only (no custom or brand typeface has been chosen).
Every screen uses the same 8px spacing/radius grid; nothing is hand-tuned per screen.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: #208AEF is the only color allowed to mean "primary action." If a second blue-ish accent shows up anywhere, it is a mistake, not a variant.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: The entire app uses exactly two font weights that matter — 500 (default) and 600/700 (title and the one bold emphasis style). A third weight anywhere is unintentional drift.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadow* or elevation prop has been used anywhere in the codebase. Any future shadow use is a deliberate new decision, not a continuation of an existing pattern.

dos: Do keep Utility Blue (#208AEF) as the only color that means "you can act here" — never introduce a second accent hue.
Do use WhatsApp Green (#25D366) exclusively for the WhatsApp contact action.
Do keep every corner radius at 8px (rounded.md) unless a component is fully circular (avatars).
Do put validation errors as red small-text below the field, never by recoloring the input border.
donts: Don't add a shadow or elevation to any component without a deliberate Elevation & Depth decision first.

Don't treat "Desactivar"/"Reportar" (text-only red) and "Cerrar sesión" (filled red button) as the same component — reconcile which destructive actions are filled vs. text-only before adding a third one.
Don't style the bottom tab bar or any new screen against a generic Material/iOS default without checking this file first.
